name: mbedtls
description: An open source, portable, easy to use, readable and flexible SSL library (overlay: the 4.0.0 development snapshot that LIEF 1.0.0 vendors).

Why an overlay exists: the vcpkg baseline ships 3.6.5, which predates the tf-psa-crypto / mbedx509 library split. LIEF 1.0.0 requires find_package(MbedTLS 4.0.0) and links MbedTLS::tfpsacrypto and MbedTLS::mbedx509, neither of which exists in 3.6.x. The pin is upstream commit ec4044008d (2025-10-13) plus the framework and TF-PSA-Crypto submodule commits it references; the build reports the upstream MBEDTLS_VERSION 4.0.0. port-version 1 records that this is a snapshot rather than the eventual 4.0.0 release.
